### TYPEOF
Returns the name of the type each value has, as its index mapped it. For a column whose indices agree on one type every row answers the same; for one they disagree about, each row answers with its own index's type. The names are the ones the mapping uses, so they match the column's `original_types`.

```esql
FROM sample_data
| EVAL type = TYPEOF(event_duration)
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY type
```
